entries.original_title: IDH mutation impairs histone demethylation and results in a block to cell differentiation
entries.original_authors: Lu, C; Ward, PS; Kapoor, GS; Rohle, D; Turcan, S; Abdel-Wahab, O; Edwards, CR; Khanin, R; Figueroa, ME; Melnick, A; Wellen, KE; O’Rourke, DM; Berger, SL; Chan, TA; Levine, RL; Mellinghoff, IK; Thompson, CB
entries.description: Expression of mutant IDH1 or IDH2 increases global histone methylation levels and produces the oncometabolite 2-hydroxyglutarate in transfected 293T cells.
entries.citation_sentence: Examination of glioma samples showed a correlation between IDH mutation status and level of overall methylation (Lu et al., 2012).
entries.notes: This is a registered report describing a planned replication protocol; no replication outcome is reported, so the result is coded inconclusive.

entries.description: Expression of mutant IDH2 blocks the differentiation of 3T3-L1 progenitor cells into adipocytes and reduces expression of adipocyte markers.
